channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Stylish city townhouse with balcony and great views up for sale for £775,000
item.description: This stylish city home set amongst some of Winchester's finest residential properties with open plan living, a balcony and courtyard garden is up for sale for £775,000.

item.title: Farage says Hampshire Reform candidate should apologise over Lammy comment
item.description: Nigel Farage said the Reform candidate who suggested David Lammy should “go home” to the Caribbean “should apologise”.

item.title: Gosport man arrested for drink-driving and driving without licence
item.description: A member of the public helped police stop a drink-driver in Gosport after spotting a man drinking alcohol while sitting in his car.

item.title: Energy secretary agrees to meet over city’s grid capacity issues
item.description: A senior government minister has agreed to meet with Southampton leaders to discuss how a lack of electricity grid capacity is holding back major investment in the city.

item.title: New 'below deck' experience on historic steamship launched
item.description: A rare opportunity to step behind the scenes and explore parts of Southampton's SS Shieldhall is being launched in 2026.

item.title: M3 and M27 closures for Southampton drivers to be aware of this weekend
item.description: Southampton drivers will need to be aware of a couple of closures on the M3 and M27 for the weekend of January 9 to 11

item.title: Inquest opens into death of New Forest man, 36, found dead on footpath
item.description: An inquest has opened into the death of a New Forest man who was found dead by the side of the road.

item.title: Swan left to suffer in freezing cold as family struggle to get it rescued
item.description: A father and daughter said they were forced to “jump through hoops” to help an injured swan that was left without assistance for more than 24 hours.

item.title: Next phase plans lodged for nearly 1,000 homes at One Horton Heath
item.description: Two major planning applications totalling more than 900 homes have been submitted to Eastleigh Borough Council as part of the next phase of One Horton Heath.

item.title: Vacant Southampton bar cannot be used as homeless shelter, councillor says
item.description: A councillor says the vacant Cenos Bar cannot be used as a homeless shelter following reports of a man staying in the building.
